create.name: NgalSo (Kunpen Lama Gangchen)
create.bio:
NgalSo is the Italian Tibetan Buddhist community gathered around the Kunpen Lama Gangchen association, which Lama Gangchen Rinpoche started in 1989 and which Italy recognises as a Buddhist religious body. It follows the NgalSo Ganden Nyengyu line passed from Gangchen Rinpoche to Lama Michel Tulku Rinpoche and Lama Caroline, and runs two places of practice: the Albagnano Healing Meditation Centre, opened in 1999 on the hillside at Bee above Verbania, and the Centro Kunpen in Milan. Groups of monks from monasteries in India and Nepal stay each year, and Lama Michel Rinpoche is the regular teacher. The association belongs to the Italian and European Buddhist unions.

Most of what happens at the two centres is open without a fee, on a free-offering basis: daily prayers and guided meditation, a Guru Puja held every day since September 2001 and dedicated to peace, courses in Buddhist philosophy and meditation, temple visits and silent retreats. The YouTube channel, running since 2013, streams this life live from Albagnano and Milan, chiefly in Italian, with long Lam Rim study evenings, introductions to Buddhism, guided meditations and ceremonies, plus short reflections by Lama Michel Rinpoche.

sprint.held: Owner decision: the community openly practises Dorje Shugden (the channel streams an 'international Dorje Shugden day' and the site hosts a Shugden prayer text), a practice the Dalai Lama (listed on Spiritpedia) has publicly opposed; a sectarian controversy rather than abuse allegations, but sensitive. Much of the centre's programme is also 'NgalSo Tantric Self-Healing', Reiki and wellbeing consultations, all left out.
sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube 130,000 subscribers (YouTube Data API, 10 Nov 2026); no other counts read → ~130k → luminary
flags: Tier borderline: 130k total is inside the 80k–150k band.
Email kunpen@gangchen.it is the association's registered-office inbox (also reception@kunpen.it for Albagnano, milano@kunpen.it for Milan).
Base given as Milan (the association's registered office); the main temple is at Bee, near Verbania (Piedmont). Regional: northern Italy outside the big cities for Albagnano.
Lama Michel Rinpoche (resident teacher, many channel talks and a new book) is not on Spiritpedia: possible future listing. Teachers file left empty.
Channel is mostly Italian; video titles kept in Italian as published.
Photos: the stupa at Albagnano and Lama Gangchen Rinpoche on a terrace at the centre (both kunpen.ngalso.org, 500 px), plus the NgalSo emblem avatar.
Retreat and course prices are not shown on the listing; the site says Dharma activities are by free offering: written 'Contact for pricing'.
left_out: NgalSo Tantric Self-Healing sessions, 'self-healing for the environment', Reiki Chawang NgalSo, astrological healing, Medicine Buddha puja and wellbeing consultations (health rule / healing framing).
Videos on anger and anxiety, self-healing Q&A, Dorje Shugden celebrations, book presentations and short promotional clips.
sprint.dropped: Dropped by the owner (11 Nov 2026): Dorje Shugden practice; programme leans on self-healing.
